id./param/scenario/cs/a_150_cs_120.pack|cs_: "So he's busy getting ready for our life beneath the sea, and that's why he said to bring me the veil?
"Oh my word, it's gorgeous! The finest in the world! I love the little seashells, ooh, and are these tiny pearls?
"But really, what's he like, taking all this time? To leave a poor girl stranded here is really a crime!
"I miss him so! But I'm sure he has his reasons. Perhaps he had to stick around for one last fishing season?
"Thank you all for helping me. Come on, why don't I show you how to sink beneath the seas?
"Strum this if a whirlpool you should spy. My friends will take you down below, and keep you safe and dry...ish!
"If Queen Marina asks for me, please tell her I'm well, and next time she sees me, she should call me Mrs Shell!
"I wonder how long Michelle's going to wait there all on her own, just like Kainoa...
"You did the right thing. If you'd told her the truth, it would have broken her heart.
"You can't live without hope. Even if that hope is just an illusion...
